available_thread.author: Rowan
available_thread.text: For the weekly handoff, please include each task’s owner display name in the task export and in report-import’s rendered report. Include all tasks as today. Unassigned tasks should display “Unassigned” in the report; their exported owner value should be null. No owner editing or new filtering is requested.

available_thread.author: Casey
available_thread.text: Previously saved export files must remain importable by report-import with their existing ID, title and status intact. Task-export and report-import are maintained and released separately. We have not selected how their feed contract should evolve for this change; use the checked-in architecture notes to identify the compatibility decision before implementation.

availability: Complete supplied synthetic request. Only the authorized copied owner-report sample and its architecture notes are available; no live integrations, deployed services or real customer data.
